title: Muraja'ah: 'Abasa whole and An-Nazi'at 1 to 32: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 30. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ (١٧) فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ (١٨) وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ (١٩) فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ (٢٠) فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ (٢١) ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ (٢٢) فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ (٢٣) فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ (٢٤) فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ (٢٥) إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ (٢٦)

questions.q: Chain recitation: each pupil recites one ayah of 79:17-32 in register order.
questions.a: 79:17-32 recited in order by the class.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 79:17-32 and one older surah to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link the weakest ayat, then log revision.
questions.a: Rubric marked with one target for each pupil.

questions.q: Extend: write your own target from today's feedback in the portal response box. Start: 'Next time I will ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Next time I will hold the madd lazim in ٱلطَّآمَّةُ for six counts.'

questions.q: Recite An-Nazi'at 79:25 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: If you could only revise for ten minutes today, which part would you choose and why?
questions.a: The weakest part first: that is where revision helps most.
